summary: Added scripts/benchmark_report.py with lead_times, pipeline_stats, render and a command line (--merge-requests FILE --pipelines FILE) that prints the two benchmark tables; a missing file, invalid JSON or a non-list prints a message on stderr and exits 2. Standard library only. 14 tests in tests/tooling/test_benchmark_report.py cover offsets, fractional seconds, rounding, odd and even medians, None values and the exit codes; ruff and mypy --strict pass on both files.
next: Use the script to regenerate the tables in docs/experiments.md
